SELECT m.mail_no ,m.class_id ,m.mail_type ,FIND_CODENAME(m.mail_type) AS mail_type_name ,m.mail_title ,m.mail_contents ,m.mail_send_date ,m.sender_id ,m.notice_no ,LISTAGG(r.mail_receiver) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY r.mail_receiver) AS receiver_id ,LISTAGG(b.member_name) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY b.member_name) AS receiver_name
FROM mail m join mail_receivers r ON(m.mail_no = r.mail_no) join member b ON(r.mail_receiver = b.member_id)
WHERE m.class_id = #{classId} AND m.sender_id = #{senderId} AND m.sender_id != r.mail_receiver
GROUP BY m.mail_no ,m.class_id ,m.mail_type ,FIND_CODENAME(m.mail_type) ,m.mail_title ,m.mail_contents ,m.mail_send_date ,m.sender_id ,m.notice_no
ORDER BY m.mail_send_date DESC

SELECT m.mail_no ,m.class_id ,m.mail_type ,FIND_CODENAME(m.mail_type) AS mail_type_name ,m.mail_title ,m.mail_contents ,m.mail_send_date ,m.sender_id ,m.notice_no ,n.notice_type AS notice_set ,LISTAGG(r.mail_receiver, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY r.mail_receiver) AS receiver_id ,LISTAGG(b.member_name, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY b.member_name) AS receiver_name
FROM mail m join mail_receivers r ON(m.mail_no = r.mail_no) join member b ON(r.mail_receiver = b.member_id) left outer join notice n ON(m.notice_no = n.notice_no)
WHERE m.mail_no = #{mailNo}
GROUP BY m.mail_no ,m.class_id ,m.mail_type ,FIND_CODENAME(m.mail_type) ,m.mail_title ,m.mail_contents ,m.mail_send_date ,m.sender_id ,m.notice_no ,n.notice_type
